acceptance_criteria.condition: The V9 runner rejects mutable or mismatched inputs, persists every interruption, and never selectively retries a planned trial.
Isolation audit requires real frozen-Skill read commands, rejects no-skill contamination, and binds raw hidden results to trial fields.
All 40 buggy public workspaces fail while all 40 references pass public and hidden contracts, with deterministic corpus hashes.
A neutral real-Codex smoke and a clean detached-worktree preflight pass before formal collection.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Exactly 120 preregistered trials are retained and analyzed only after the final isolation audit passes.

invariants: V8 remains historical and is never cited as capability evidence.
References and hidden tests are unavailable to repair agents; the scorer injects tests only and never reference implementations.
The primary contrast is new_skill minus old_skill and both preregistered cohorts must independently pass every gate.
Interrupted or excluded trials remain recorded and make collection ineligible; no selective retry is allowed.
All non-secret prompts, outputs, logs, diffs, scores, audits, results, and hashes are retained.

safeguards.name: immutable preregistration
safeguards.rationale: Model, Harness, Skill snapshots, prompts, corpus, executable scripts, timeouts, order, and thresholds are hash-bound before collection.

safeguards.name: condition isolation
safeguards.rationale: Automatic Skill search is disabled, no_skill receives no Skill path, and treatment conditions must show an actual read command for the correct frozen snapshot.

safeguards.name: append-only evidence
safeguards.rationale: Every planned trial has a unique output directory; existing paths are rejected and interruption is terminal for the collection.

design_boundary.rationale: The runner owns execution and checkpointing, the scorer owns hidden tests, the auditor owns eligibility, and the analyzer owns statistical conclusions.

dependency_audit.rationale: The V9 protocol adds no dependency and uses repository Python plus the frozen Codex binary.

extension_decision.rationale: V9 is a versioned experiment surface rather than a shared application extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Agent-visible workspaces, hidden tests, references, raw artifacts, collection records, and analysis outputs have separate owners and lifecycle boundaries.

error_model.rationale: Agent timeout, nonzero exit, runner exception, public failure, hidden failure, scope violation, integrity failure, and isolation failure remain distinct persisted outcomes.

contract_evolution.rationale: V9 is a new schema-v2 protocol; historical V5 through V8 records remain unchanged and non-evidentiary where documented.

operational_budget.rationale: Formal collection has fixed 420-second Agent and 30-second test timeouts, 40 tasks, three conditions, and no early stopping.

threat_boundary.rationale: The protocol rejects symlinks, hash drift, reference injection, unexpected edits, automatic Skill search, and mismatched Skill sources; this is protocol isolation, not a security sandbox.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: V9 code and corpus are frozen first, preregistration is committed second, and collection runs only from a clean detached worktree.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline local evaluation and performs no production rollout.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema or user data is migrated.

configuration_secrets.rationale: Only non-secret runtime identifiers and hashes are retained; user configuration is disabled and secret values are excluded from artifacts.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package, lockfile, or external service dependency is added or changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: references/effect-evaluation.md documents the protocol, evidence limits, failure handling, and interpretation owner.

reproducibility.rationale: Corpus, prompts, snapshots, scripts, model, CLI version, order, seed, timeouts, clean worktree, and every artifact digest are retained.

causal.symptom: V8 hidden scoring could replace candidate implementation files, and the current V9 runner tests do not yet match its schema-v2 and balanced-order contract.
causal.discriminating_check: Run the V9 runner, scorer, isolation, preregistration, corpus, and analyzer tests, followed by a real neutral smoke and clean detached preflight.
causal.upstream_path: frozen inputs -> isolated Agent invocation -> public check -> tests-only hidden scoring -> checkpoint -> isolation audit -> cohort analysis
causal.timeline_evidence: V8 historical files predate the V9 split layout; the first current runner test execution failed at missing envelope, seed, and old-order fixtures before formal collection.
